Dangling-reference repairs:
- "Failure to take account of it is the source of much of the unjust criticism leveled against pragmatism." The referring word "it" pointed to the framing sentence "The point I now urge you to observe particularly is the part played by the older truths." Repair: name span. "it" is replaced with "the part played by the older truths", taken from that framing sentence. The framing sentence itself was dropped. It only directs the reader's attention, and its "I" would otherwise need an author name span.
- "It must both lean on old truth and grasp new fact; and its success (as I said a moment ago) in doing this..." The referring words were "(as I said a moment ago)". Repair: first-person cut, made mid-sentence. This leaves two quotes joined by `{ }`.
- "Mr. Schiller still gives to all this view of truth the name of 'Humanism,' ... so I will treat it under the name of pragmatism in these lectures." The referring words were "so I will treat it under the name of pragmatism in these lectures". Repair: first-person cut of the tail. That tail is the author's statement of his own naming practice and carries no argument. The quote now ends at "ascendant", with a period added.

Generic "we"/"you" left unrepaired:
- "in this matter of belief we are all extreme conservatives"
- "all our preconceptions"
- "We should scratch round industriously"
- "We hold a theory true"
- "We say this theory solves it... more satisfactorily to ourselves"
- "our preconceptions"
- "our experience"
- "Truth is what we say about them, and when we say"
- "We are in the process and obey the reasons"
- "our double urgency"
- "why we call things true"
- "truth that we FIND merely"
- "in our day"
- "our ancestors"

All of these mean people in general.

Dropped statements:
- "The point I now urge you to observe particularly is the part played by the older truths." This is framing, replaced by the name span above.
- "Time and space, cause and effect, nature and history, and one's own biography remain untouched." Dropped as illustration.
- "You doubtless wish examples of this process of truth's growth, and the only trouble is their superabundance." Dropped as a transition.
- The shrieking-on-the-platform example. Dropped as illustration.
- The radium, helium and Ramsay example, through "...it causes a minimum of alteration in their nature." Dropped as illustration.
- "I need not multiply instances." Dropped as a transition.
- "And these two things must be our future topics." Dropped as a forward hook.

No asides.
